subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should all group and channel rooms lose fallback notices by default, or should rooms receive a sanitized notice that omits model names and provider/auth error details?
rationale: Current behavior deliberately exposes operational transitions, while this PR globally removes them from shared rooms; source code cannot determine the intended privacy-versus-observability product policy.

options.title: Use room-safe notices
options.body: Keep a generic fallback/recovery notice in rooms while omitting model, provider, and error details, and retain full notices in direct chats.

options.title: Suppress all room notices
options.body: Adopt the PR's global room policy after preserving lifecycle events and proving both room and direct-chat behavior.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep current delivery until a narrower configurable or administrator-aware policy is designed without expanding config unnecessarily.

recommendation.title: Use room-safe notices
recommendation.body: Keep a generic fallback/recovery notice in rooms while omitting model, provider, and error details, and retain full notices in direct chats.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows sustained ownership of reply-runner behavior and silent-delivery boundaries on this central path.
